svg.title: Route Server control plane and NVA data path
svg.desc: Route Server exchanges BGP routes with an RRAS NVA. Application traffic goes through the NVA, never through Route Server. Spoke1 has no Virtual WAN hub connection. A 10.100.0.0/16 advertisement is synthetic and has no deployed destination.
